cases.title: After coronary bypass
cases.male: A man with diabetes has incisional pain, shallow breathing and a new fall in pressure.
cases.female: A woman with prior ventricular dysfunction has the same operation and new congestion.

cases.title: Aortic, mitral or tricuspid repair/replacement
cases.male: A man after mechanical aortic replacement develops bradycardia and reduced urine output.
cases.female: A woman after mitral repair develops breathlessness and congestion.

cases.title: Thoracic aortic repair or dissection
cases.male: A man after dissection repair becomes hypertensive and reports new pain.
cases.female: A woman after arch repair develops reduced urine output and a focal neurological change.

cases.title: VA-ECMO for cardiac failure
cases.male: A man on VA-ECMO after myocardial injury develops cool extremities and rising lactate.
cases.female: A woman on VA-ECMO after surgery develops pulmonary congestion despite displayed circuit flow.

cases.title: Early or established LVAD support
cases.male: A man soon after LVAD implantation develops venous congestion and reduced device flow.
cases.female: A woman with an established LVAD has alarms, dark urine and falling hemoglobin.

cases.title: Temporary microaxial flow-pump support
cases.male: A man supported with an Impella develops access-site swelling and a cooler leg.
cases.female: A woman supported with an Impella develops dark urine and a falling hemoglobin.

cases.title: Immediate heart-transplant recovery
cases.male: A man after heart transplant develops low output and worsening kidney function.
cases.female: A woman after heart transplant has a new rhythm change and rising support needs.

cases.title: Lobectomy or pneumonectomy
cases.male: A man after lobectomy has pain-limited coughing and a rising oxygen requirement.
cases.female: A woman after pneumonectomy develops breathlessness and a new circulation change.

cases.title: Single or double lung transplantation
cases.male: A man early after bilateral transplant develops impaired oxygenation and opacities.
cases.female: A woman after single-lung transplant develops hypoxemia with altered airway pressures.

cases.title: Esophagectomy
cases.male: A man after esophagectomy develops tachycardia, new oxygen need and chest discomfort.
cases.female: A woman after esophagectomy develops fever, hypotension and altered drain findings.

cases.title: Tracheal reconstruction or mediastinal surgery
cases.male: A man after tracheal reconstruction develops stridor and distress.
cases.female: A woman after mediastinal tumor surgery develops positional breathing difficulty and hypotension.

cases.title: Open or endovascular abdominal aortic repair
cases.male: A man after open AAA repair develops abdominal distension and reduced urine output.
cases.female: A woman after endovascular repair develops new pain and falling pressure.

cases.title: Carotid endarterectomy
cases.male: A man after carotid endarterectomy develops neck swelling and voice change.
cases.female: A woman after the same operation develops severe headache and a new focal deficit.

cases.title: Complex limb revascularization
cases.male: A man after lower-limb bypass develops increasing pain, tense swelling and sensory change.
cases.female: A woman after revascularization has a newly cool foot with diminished Doppler signals.

cases.title: Cardiogenic shock without a completed operation
cases.male: A man with acute myocardial injury has cool skin, oliguria and pulmonary edema.
cases.female: A woman with acute severe ventricular dysfunction has hypotension and increasing respiratory effort.

cases.title: Severe respiratory failure or ARDS
cases.male: A man with severe pneumonia develops diffuse lung injury and worsening oxygenation.
cases.female: A woman with a similar lung injury develops hypercapnia and ventilator dyssynchrony.

cases.title: Complicated infective endocarditis
cases.male: A man with valve infection develops pulmonary edema and low output.
cases.female: A woman with suspected valve infection develops shock and a focal neurological change.

cases.title: A goals-concordant course with advanced cardiorespiratory failure
cases.male: A man with persistent multiorgan failure chooses a comfort-focused plan after an informed discussion.
cases.female: A woman with severe lung disease declines intubation but requests treatment of a potentially reversible infection.
